items.headline: Coastal Flood Statement issued November 5 at 3:04AM EST until November 5 at 7:00PM EST by NWS Miami FL
items.description:
* WHAT...Isolated minor coastal flooding is possible around
periods of high tide.

* WHERE...Coastal Palm Beach County.

* WHEN...Through Thursday evening.

* IMPACTS...Some water on low lying roads and property.
items.instruction: Do not drive through flooded roadways.
